title: Harden native relay refusal reason mapping and cover receipt/capacity reason codes
outcome: Harden native relay refusal reason mapping and cover receipt/capacity reason codes
acceptance: Reason classification uses shared constants or typed producer errors, or equivalent behavioral coverage makes supported mapping drift observable; unknown messages retain bounded reason-unavailable fallback without raw prose.
Behavioral assertions cover receipt-gap, unissued and foreign-receipt reason prefixes plus an RPC-capacity refusal while preserving status, authentication, receipt semantics and outcome uncertainty.
